issues: Missing keyword "bane"; add it to `keywords` for the printed Bane ability.

The fanfare effect is conditional on turning 3 facedown evolved followers in your evolve deck face up; encode it as a single gated/paid effect (not two separate unconditional fanfare abilities), so the destroy only happens if that evolve-deck action is performed.

Strike ability is incorrectly encoded as a dummy `if` with `namedCardNotOnFieldByName` and `noop`; it should encode: if there are at least 5 faceup evolved followers in your evolve deck, heal your leader 3, and if there are at least 8, deal 3 damage to each enemy leader. Implement missing condition support for counting faceup evolved followers in evolve deck (e.g. `evolveDeckFaceupMin`) to represent both thresholds.
Missing keyword "ward"; add it to `keywords` for the printed Ward ability.

Activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly as `cost: { "pp": 1, "discard": 1 }`; it should require paying 1 PP, discarding this card, and discarding a Dragoncraft card that costs 7 or more from hand. Use an activated cost including self-discard/bury plus the hand discard, and implement a missing activated-cost form for discarding this card from hand (or equivalent hand self-discard cost support).

The discarded Dragoncraft card filter should match cards that cost 7 or more; the current `discardFromHand` step uses `minCost: 7` correctly, but the self-discard portion of the card text is missing and must be included in the cost/effect.
Fanfare is missing its cost; add `cost: { "pp": 1 }` to the fanfare ability to represent `[fanfare] [cost01]`.

The cemetery effect is encoded incorrectly as `tutorFromCemetery` with `playCostReduction: 1`; it should put a Faith follower from your cemetery into your EX area, then give that moved card [attack]+1, not reduce its play cost.
